newsitem.title: UK: Unilever up after ADRs surge.
newsitem.headline: Unilever up after ADRs surge.

text.p: Shares in Unilever Plc were up 39p to 15.76-1/2 stg by 0840 GMT after American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) in the Anglo-Dutch consumer products group soared in New York on Friday.
The ADRs closed on Friday at $188-1/4, up $8-1/4, boosted by a rise in profits and the planned sale of its specialty chemicals units, traders said.
"The stock was well bid in the U.S. on Friday. We're just seeing London play catch-up," one dealer said.

Last week the company reported a 15 percent rise in annual profits, to 2.66 billion stg ($4.4 billion) and said it would sell its specialty chemicals units in a move expected to raise up to five billion stg.
